name: viewtube-root
description: ViewTube Full-Stack Platform - Root Workspace Controller

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix admin install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ADMIN" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold,magenta.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix admin run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix admin run build
